# Dental Job Board — llms.txt

## About
A job board for dental practices in the Kansas City metro. 20 real openings, each link-verified live at launch: mostly Registered Dental Hygienist roles, plus dental assistant and front-office roles. Every listing links to the employer's real application page.

## Post a job
- Standard listing, $99 for 30 days: https://buy.stripe.com/4gMfZi8Ng8VNgsSaiM0gw0y
- Featured listing, $199 for 30 days: https://buy.stripe.com/00w8wQ4x05JB2C2ez20gw0z
- Post a job: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/dental-jobs/post-a-job/
- Listings go live after payment.

## Job alerts
Free email alerts for new dental jobs: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/dental-jobs/ (signup on every page).
